command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== webui routes ==='
grep -nE '8784|do_GET|do_POST|/health|/api|terminal|command' ~/.claude/star/local_bridge_webui.py | head -160 || true
echo '=== mcp routes/config hints ==='
grep -RniE '8789|health|/mcp|FastAPI|HTTPServer|serve_forever' ~/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp 2>/dev/null | head -160 || true
echo '=== HTTP probes ==='
for u in http://127.0.0.1:8784/ http://127.0.0.1:8784/health http://127.0.0.1:8789/ http://127.0.0.1:8789/health http://127.0.0.1:8789/mcp; do
  echo "--- $u"
  curl -sS -m 4 -D - "$u" -o /tmp/omega-probe-body || true
  head -c 700 /tmp/omega-probe-body 2>/dev/null || true
  echo
done
